name: @equin/plugin-packages-parked-watch
description: Watches parked until their target is known: createParkedWatches({ onOpenError }) holds a watch on a key whose target (a conversation's worktree) is not resolvable yet, and opens it from the first load that resolves the target — the park taken before the subscribe's own resolve, so a target found while that resolve is in flight still opens it; a parked open that fails is reported and re-parked, so the next resolving load retries it.
